title: Exchange-stable Ds states span both margin regimes; ascent selects the funnel at scale
statement: Exact full-lattice census (N = 10..14, K = 3, centered06 + mix3 grid laws, integer-exact stability classification selftested against an independent from-scratch oracle): one-point exchange-stable profiled-Ds states are plentiful (18-944 per instance) and overwhelmingly non-global; on the centered law their nuisance blocks span 1e-5 to 0.57 with value gap and nuisance block anti-correlated (-0.27 to -0.83 per instance), margin-retaining non-global stable states exist in every instance at a Theta(1) price, and stable states with nearly coincident projected centroids occur (min separation 5.5e-4), so (M5) must be checked, never assumed. The efficient-score DP interval labeling - the documented profiled initializer - is exchange-UNSTABLE in 7/10 centered-law instances (already at N = 8, exact gain 0.447, the improving move growing the nuisance block 27-fold) while stable in 9/10 mix3 instances. Exact best-gain ascent terminals at N <= 14 are strongly seed-dependent. At library scale (N = 100/300/1000, optimize_partition + ProfiledDOptimality + DExchangeConfig), EVERY seeding (efficient-score labels, k-means++, random) terminates on the centered law with the nuisance block collapsing at the K/N scale (N * I11 median 0.5-3.0) and near-optimal value (log-gap 0.004-0.046 to the certified DP ceiling) - the DS16 funnel in action, seed-independently - while on mix3 every seeding keeps lambda_min ~ 1.7 = Theta(1) with log-gaps <= 2e-4.
assumptions: grid-law emulations (atomic), deterministic seeds 20260830 + 1000N + rep; library runs float64 with gain_tolerance 1e-10
measured, never theorem authority; the asymptotic selection law is open (OPEN-DS-STABLE-BASINS)

proof_location.section: DS16. Margin price at arbitrary labelings, the value funnel, and the profiled compile verdict

role: the selection-effects evidence separating properties of stable states from properties of the seeding (packet blocker 5)
